Subject: Dalmora Manufacturing - Quote in Progress

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Dalmora Manufacturing! I've received the application, statement of values, and loss runs—everything looks complete.

I'm working on putting together a competitive quote for the December 10, 2026 effective date. I'll review the $2.6M total insured value across the location and the loss history, and should have something back to you shortly.

I'll reach out if any questions come up during my review, but at this point we're moving forward with pricing.

Thanks for thinking of us on this one!

Best regards,  
[Underwriter name]
